$Comment: Introduce yourself to all three quest givers. Each line is a TALK_TO_NPC against a character
id, credited only where that character's own conversation says so with a MarkTalked action -
Criteria is an ORDERED list and the order is permanent: progress is filed per criterion by its
POSITION, so adding a fourth giver to the END is safe while reordering these three would move
every player's progress onto a different character.
